fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of the "type" command to download/upload data from WebDAV server
fields.name: Potential Download/Upload Activity Using Type Command
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "type " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " > \\\\") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "type \\\\" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " > ")))
